verdict.rationale: AFK runs processes as directed graphs, so throttling or queuing executions is a fair question for this product. The evidence only covers dependency ordering: parallel branches run concurrently and blocked nodes resume when their dependencies clear. Nothing in the pack documents rate limiting, concurrency caps, throttling, or execution queues that respect downstream API limits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can throttle or queue workflow executions to respect downstream rate limits
